findings.title: Timestamp-window run discovery can bind to another mutation
findings.body: Workflow serialization does not make run discovery unique: multiple requests can be created or queued for the same workflow within one timestamp window, with the same event type and actor. The CLI can thereforefollow another invocation, report its PR, or return success while its own mutation failed. MCP callers would also receive no reliable operation handle.
findings.code:
- run 특정·추적: workflow_dispatch는 run id를 돌려주지 않으므로, 디스패치 직후 해당 워크플로의
  run 목록을 짧게 폴링해 자기 run을 특정한다(디스패치 시각 창 + 이벤트 타입 필터). 추적은 run
  conclusion까지가 기본이고, 실패 시 실패 잡 이름과 run URL을 보고한다.
findings.recommendation: Add an authoritative correlation key carried through dispatcher input, run-name, branch or output, or another unambiguous dispatch receipt. Require overlap, retry, and queued-run tests; do not accepttimestamp matching as the identity mechanism.

findings.title: The secrets chain can dispatch a commit the workflow never reads
findings.body: Repository-directory detection does not establish that the checkout is the canonical app repository on a fresh main branch. The existing update-secrets workflow reads the app repository's main HEAD. Running thisplan from a feature branch can successfully seal, commit, and push, then dispatch against the old main secret. The plan also gives no resumable behavior when push succeeds but dispatch fails, which is especially dangerousduring credential rotation.
findings.code:
- app secrets 이중 모드: 실행 디렉토리가 대상 앱 레포이면 seal(기존 seal 도구 위임)→커밋→push→
  update-secrets 디스패치를 연쇄하고, 아니면 디스패치만 한다. 평문은 kubeseal stdin 전용 —
  값은 어떤 출력에도 나타나지 않는다(봉인 계약 규율 유지).
findings.recommendation: Specify remote identity, clean-worktree, branch and freshness preconditions; stage only the sealed artifact; prove the pushed commit is reachable from main before dispatch; and define retry/resumebehavior for every partial-failure boundary. Test feature branches, dirty trees, divergent remotes, and push-success/dispatch-failure.

findings.title: Open question: --wait has no correct per-verb completion state machine
findings.body: One generic sequence cannot implement the current contracts: create-app is manual-merge, teardown explicitly remains manual, while other mutations auto-merge. Even on auto-merge paths, an ArgoCD Application mayalready be Healthy for the previous revision, so a health-only check can falsely report 'actually deployed'. DB and cache mutations also affect different Application sets. The plan leaves engineers to guess whether manualverbs block, reject --wait, or return an incomplete result.
findings.code:
- 대기 시맨틱: 기본 = run 완료 + 산출 PR URL 출력. --wait = auto-merge 완료(required check
  gate 단일 — ADR 0003) 후 ArgoCD healthy까지. KUBECONFIG 부재 시 --wait는 머지까지 확인하고
  라이브 구간 생략을 명시한다. 폴링 간격·데드라인은 주입 가능(테스트 심).
findings.recommendation: Define a state machine per verb: exact run, exact PR, manual versus automatic merge behavior, merge SHA, affected Application set, observed sync revision or generation, and Healthy state. Define timeoutand partial-result semantics, including how omitted live verification affects success.

findings.title: app init has no idempotency or recovery design across irreversible side effects
findings.body: The chain crosses GitHub repository creation, local filesystem changes, git push, and two independent secret writes without preflight, compensation, or resume rules. A failure after repository creation leaves aname collision that a retry cannot follow as written; failure after setting one dispatch secret leaves the repository in the known invalid half-configured state.
findings.code:
- app init 체인: 템플릿 레포에서 새 레포 생성(기본 private, --public 옵트인) → 클론 →
  스캐폴더 비대화형 실행(--archetype fullstack|api|site|worker — kind는 아키타입 유도값, CONTEXT.md
  용어) → 커밋 → 첫push. --dispatch-secrets 지정 시에만 App 키 경로를 받아 새 레포에 디스패치
  시크릿 쌍을 설정한다(기본 미배선 = 크론 백스톱).
findings.recommendation: Define phased preflight and postcondition checks, an explicit policy for compatible existing repositories, cleanup or resume instructions at every boundary, and reconciliation or rollback for apartially written secret pair. Add failure-injection tests after each external side effect.

findings.title: The promised stable JSON and MCP contract is not actually specified
findings.body: Naming a top-level success flag, verb, and result object does not settle a shared API. Exact per-verb fields and types, error payloads, null versus omitted values, warnings, skipped segments, no-op results,schema versioning, and the mapping from process exit codes to MCP errors are all absent. Independent tickets will have to invent incompatible shapes, and the proposed tests have no authoritative contract to assert.
findings.code:
- --json 계약: 전 동사가 안정된 최상위 형태(성공 여부·동사·결과 오브젝트: run URL·PR URL·상태
  등)를 출력한다. MCP tool 결과도 같은 오브젝트를 재사용한다(계약 한 벌).
- 종료코드: 기존 도구 규약(0=성공 · 1=검증/게이트 실패 · 2=사용법 오류 · 3=race · 4=skip +
  SKIP 마커) 준수.
findings.recommendation: Add a versioned checked-in schema with discriminated success, failure, skip, no-op, partial, and in-progress variants; define exact per-verb results, stdout purity, compatibility rules, and MCP errormapping; then test every variant as golden JSON.

findings.title: The known amd64 blocker is not made a release prerequisite
findings.body: The plan acknowledges that the template currently emits arm64-targeted binaries, but places the repair outside the homelab gate without an explicit dependency or pinned compatible template revision. The CLI cantherefore pass all local stub tests and ship before the template fix, causing its first promised NUC deployment to fail with an exec-format error.
findings.code:
- 크로스레포 티켓 — 템플릿 arm64 수리: 템플릿 아키타입들의 빌드 대상 하드코딩(bun-linux-arm64)을
  TARGETARCH 파라미터화로 수리한다(선행 수정된 기존 앱 2곳과 같은 방식). 이 작업은 템플릿 레포에서
  수행되며homelab 브랜치 게이트 범위 밖임을 명시한다.
findings.recommendation: Make the template repair and an automated amd64 scaffold-build-smoke result blocking dependencies of CLI release. Pin or verify the compatible template revision so later template drift cannot silentlyreintroduce the failure.

findings.title: Wait can succeed on the previously deployed revision
findings.body: The plan waits for merge and then only for ArgoCD health. An Application can remain Healthy while the requested merge is still OutOfSync, so this poll can terminate immediately on the pre-merge deployment. Thisrepository already treats health without revision binding as unsafe in tools/activate-app.ts. The CLI would tell humans and agents that a new image, secret, or resource is deployed when it is not.
findings.code:
- 대기 시맨틱: 기본 = run 완료 + 산출 PR URL 출력. --wait = auto-merge 완료(required check
  gate 단일 — ADR 0003) 후 ArgoCD healthy까지. KUBECONFIG 부재 시 --wait는 머지까지 확인하고
  라이브 구간 생략을 명시한다. 폴링 간격·데드라인은 주입 가능(테스트 심).
findings.recommendation: Record the PR merge SHA and require Synced plus an observed sync revision equal to or descending from that SHA before accepting Healthy. Specify timeout and later-main behavior, and test a stale-Healthy/OutOfSync fixture.

findings.title: Run discovery can attach to another caller's mutation
findings.body: A workflow, event type, and time window do not uniquely identify a dispatch. Concurrent CLI or MCP calls, or a retry after an uncertain dispatch response, can produce multiple matching runs before workflowconcurrency serializes their execution. Following the wrong run can report another mutation's PR or success while this request failed. The existing race exit code does not help unless ambiguity is explicitly detected.
findings.code:
- run 특정·추적: workflow_dispatch는 run id를 돌려주지 않으므로, 디스패치 직후 해당 워크플로의
  run 목록을 짧게 폴링해 자기 run을 특정한다(디스패치 시각 창 + 이벤트 타입 필터). 추적은 run
  conclusion까지가 기본이고, 실패 시 실패 잡 이름과 run URL을 보고한다.
findings.recommendation: Define a provable correlation protocol, such as a request ID carried into run-name, even if that requires revising the dispatcher-contract scope. Otherwise require exactly one candidate and fail closedwith exit 3. Test simultaneous dispatches and retry-after-timeout.

findings.title: Open question: how does wait behave for manual-merge mutations?
findings.body: The blanket wait definition requires auto-merge, while teardown explicitly forbids it and the existing create-app workflow also requires manual merge because merge is first-deployment and exposure approval. Animplementer must either wait forever, reject --wait, or weaken an existing human approval boundary. The plan does not choose among them.
findings.code:
- teardown confirm 가드: --confirm <앱이름> 플래그가 디스패처의 confirm 입력으로 전달된다.
  플래그 부재 시 TTY면 재입력 프롬프트, 비-TTY면 거부. auto-merge를 켜는 어떤 경로도 두지 않는다
  (머지는 수동 = 기존파괴 경계 정책).
findings.recommendation: Add a per-command wait matrix. For create-app and teardown, preserve manual approval and define whether --wait observes an externally performed merge, returns a bounded pending result, or is rejected.Test each policy explicitly.

findings.title: Open question: how is app init resumed after partial failure?
findings.body: The first step creates durable remote state, followed by several fallible local and remote operations. A clone, scaffold, commit, push, or one-of-two secret-setting failure leaves a repository that the literalretry path can no longer create, with no checkpoint, ownership proof, cleanup rule, or resume semantics. The promised one-command flow can therefore strand the first onboarding attempt.
findings.code:
- app init 체인: 템플릿 레포에서 새 레포 생성(기본 private, --public 옵트인) → 클론 →
  스캐폴더 비대화형 실행(--archetype fullstack|api|site|worker — kind는 아키타입 유도값, CONTEXT.md
  용어) → 커밋 → 첫push. --dispatch-secrets 지정 시에만 App 키 경로를 받아 새 레포에 디스패치
  시크릿 쌍을 설정한다(기본 미배선 = 크론 백스톱).
findings.recommendation: Specify preflight-before-create, checkpointed/idempotent retry behavior, safe recognition of a repository created by this invocation, and explicit cleanup guidance. Fault-inject every boundary,including failure after setting only one dispatch secret.

findings.title: Open question: what blocks release on the external template fix?
findings.body: The plan acknowledges that the template currently emits an arm64-hardcoded target while the required host is amd64, but places the fix outside this branch's gate without declaring it a release prerequisite. TheCLI can therefore pass its own gate and create an app that predictably fails with an exec-format error. Consuming a mutable external template also leaves later scaffold-contract version skew unaddressed.

  TARGETARCH 파라미터화로 수리한다(선행 수정된 기존 앱 2곳과 같은 방식). 이 작업은 템플릿 레포에서
  수행되며homelab 브랜치 게이트 범위 밖임을 명시한다.
findings.recommendation: Make the template ticket a blocking dependency, identify a compatible template ref or explicit scaffold contract version, have doctor reject incompatible versions, and require amd64 plus multiarchscaffold/build/smoke evidence before this feature is accepted.

findings.title: Open question: what exactly is the stable JSON contract?
findings.body: Only three illustrative top-level concepts are named. There is no schema version, command-specific result shape, error envelope, timeout or pending representation, skipped-live-state representation, or rulemapping stdout to exit codes. Different tickets can implement mutually incompatible objects while each satisfies this prose, and the stated tests have no concrete stable contract to assert.
findings.code:
- --json 계약: 전 동사가 안정된 최상위 형태(성공 여부·동사·결과 오브젝트: run URL·PR URL·상태
  등)를 출력한다. MCP tool 결과도 같은 오브젝트를 재사용한다(계약 한 벌).
- 종료코드: 기존 도구 규약(0=성공 · 1=검증/게이트 실패 · 2=사용법 오류 · 3=race · 4=skip +
  SKIP 마커) 준수.
findings.recommendation: Commit a versioned JSON Schema or discriminated TypeScript contract covering every verb and every success, error, skip, race, pending, and timeout state. Define stdout/stderr and exit-code mapping, thentest serialized fixtures for CLI and MCP.

findings.title: Open question: what is the MCP operation and workspace model?
findings.body: The server promises short calls and later status polling but defines neither an operation handle nor durable background execution. app init has no deployment status to poll before registration, and app secretsdepends on the caller's repository directory while a stdio server has one fixed working directory. An implementation must guess whether to block, orphan background work, or silently select dispatch-only mode; concurrentcalls also cannot be tied back to their initiating tool call.
findings.code:
- MCP 서버 모드: stdio transport. 노출 = 파괴 제외 전부(app init/create/secrets, db create/url,
  cache create/url, status, doctor). teardown은 CLI 전용. tool 호출은 짧게 —
  긴 대기는 하지 않고 status 재호출을안내한다.
findings.recommendation: Define explicit workspace or destination inputs and a per-tool synchronization boundary. Either return a correlated run or durable operation ID with an operation-status contract, or keep local multi-step verbs out of MCP until that lifecycle exists. Test server restart and concurrent calls.

triage: herdr-review-gate SKILL.md §§ Triage and Rounds govern. Start at `triageHeader`. Render EVERY finding as a full table row — `ID | Finding (title + full body) | Severity | file:line | Code | Quotation | Recommendation | Proposed decision` — never truncated and never inside a dialog, in the order given — `section: consensus` rows first, adjacent rows already together. A row's `adjacency.withRows` names the others in its group: put a group to ONE decision. A row carrying `priorDecision` was rejected or deferred before — its reason is on the row, and re-raising it needs new evidence. Then ask the ROUND before the rows — take every Proposed decision as it stands, approve the consensus section wholesale, or decide row by row — and either of the first two ends that part in ONE action; only if row-by-row was chosen, ask per finding with that row's Proposed decision first, a reject or defer taking a free-text reason. ON ROUND 2 the re-verification rows are findings of FACT: confirm or correct them against the code and do NOT offer Reject or Defer on them — only rows still open after re-verification, and new findings, take the full triage. A `question` row is resolved by asking the reviewer IN ITS PANE: it is still running, `panel.members[].tabId` names it. WHEN TRIAGE IS DONE, close each open member pane with `herdr tab close <tabId>` — this gate deliberately left them open for you and nothing else will. Echo back ONLY the rows that carried free text. Max 2 rounds. Append the decided rows to `docs/reviews/<slug>/decisions.md` under a `### <gate> r<n> (<reviewer>)` heading — one line per row, `<ID> <decision> — <finding title>[; <reason for reject/defer>]`, and an accepted waiver as `WAIVED by user: <reason>` — then COMMIT it with this artifact. That grammar is not decoration — the conductors parse it, so a ledger written in any other shape reads back as a gate still owed.
